name: Can I make changes to my custom floor plan after initial approval?

mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to my custom floor plan after initial approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to make changes to your custom floor plan after initial approval, but this may incur additional costs and extend the development timeline. Our process typically includes a set number of revisions within the initial scope. Significant changes beyond these revisions often require re-drafting and re-evaluation, which will be discussed and quoted transparently. We encourage clients to be thorough during the initial review stages to minimize such adjustments later on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Changes to your custom floor plan after initial approval are possible but may incur extra costs and extend the timeline.
